summary.goal: Squat-heavy block, sumo moderate (alternating-axial-emphasis). The squat climbs a gated ladder, 315 -> 365 -> 385 -> 405, where each floor is unlocked by a FINE morning back check, and W2-W4 carry a range above the floor up to a hard ceiling (385 / 405 / 435). Bench, pull-up and dip keep strive waves with staggered peaks: dip in W3, bench and pull-up in W4. W5 deloads.
changes: SQUAT floor -> range -> ceiling (athlete, 2026-09-27): W1 315x3 fixed (still on baclofen). W2 365 up to 385, W3 385 up to 405, W4 405 working up to @8, ceiling 435. The range is earned on the day: last check FINE, off meds with a clean unmedicated check, last week's top <=@7.5, crisp warm-ups. Next week's floor never moves with the range. Above the ceiling forfeits the next rung.

SUMO re-set (athlete, 2026-09-27): 255 / 265 / 275 / 285 / 235, triples x3 @6, +10 a week, each step gated on the sumo back check. It stays under B5's 295 so the squat peaks alone in W4. B7 is the heavy-sumo block.
Comp bench W4 is 'work up to @8: 275-285x2' (cap-is-a-target); it holds at 255 in W3 so it doesn't peak with the dip.
Dip peaks in W3 (work up to @8: BW+105-110x3) and holds in W4. Pull-up peaks in W4 with a hard stop at @8 (BW+90-95x3).
Squat and deadlift secondary pools are fully Blocked - medical, so there is no squat or sumo secondary. Spoto (D4) and CGB (D3) are held.
Squat backoffs are fours, not fives (4-4-4-3-3 sets), keyed to the floor.
accessory_changes: WHOLE-BODY EVERY DAY (athlete, 2026-09-24): D1 + Iso-Lateral Row (Machine) 125 -> 130 per arm (a pull on Monday); D3 + Leg Extension 130 -> 140 (lower body on Thursday).
ROTATED: DB Shoulder Press -> Single Arm Landmine Press, plates-only floor 50 lb (athlete, 2026-09-27; 25 was too light).
EXPANSION: Chest Fly (Machine) on D1, chest isolation rather than a fifth press.
BACK after the medication course: Bulgarian Split Squat (D4). MOVED: Hip Thrust D3 -> D2, off the day before sumo.
DROPPED: Leg Press and Weighted Back Extension. STILL OUT: Incline DB Press, all overhead barbell work, upright row.
Core every day, a different pattern each day: Side Plank, Pallof, Dead Bug, Bird Dog.
